$schema_note: Machine-readable inventory of real UI components in console/, as of 2026-07-29. Descriptive, not prescriptive. Two layers coexist: the vendored @fleetbase/ember-ui addon (older, Bootstrap-era class conventions like btn-{type}-{size}) and the Lipu-specific layer at app/components/lipu/ui/ (Tailwind-based, the one to treat as canonical going forward for new UI).

variants.secondary: text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-600
variants.inline: border-0 bg-transparent shadow-none text-lipu-500 dark:text-lipu-400 hover:bg-transparent focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-lipu-500
variants.ghost: border-0 bg-transparent shadow-none text-lipu-600 dark:text-lipu-400 hover:text-lipu-700

canonical.note: sizes are ignored for inline/ghost variants, which force px-0 py-0 text-sm
canonical.baseClass: lipu-ui-button [lipu-ui-button--inline] cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors [shadow-sm] {sizeClass} {variantClass}
canonical.renders: <LinkTo> when @route is given, else <button>; both branches share icon/label/spinner logic (FaIcon left/right + label span)

legacyPrimitive.note: Older, non-Tailwind class convention. Not the one to document as the pattern for new work; kept here because it still underlies some vendored screens.

vendorBadge.pattern: status-badge {type|status|'info'}-status-badge, inner span status-badge-inner-wrap with rounded/rounded-full + text-xs font-medium
vendorBadge.note: color comes from vendor CSS class combinations, not inline Tailwind color utilities

vendorPill.pattern: fleetbase-pill > a.flex.flex-row.space-x-2, avatar w-7 h-7 rounded-full ring-2, title text-sm, subtitle text-xs text-gray-400

domainExamples.baseClass: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold

cards.note: No single canonical Card component — ~40 independent *-card.* files exist, mostly domain-specific, not a shared kit.

referenceExample.pattern: bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-6; title text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mb-3; value h2 with inline style font-size:30px;font-weight:500;line-height:150%; metrics row flex items-center space-x-6

inputGroup.pattern: div.input-group > Input.w-full.form-input; no explicit error/focus styling in template, relies on .form-input CSS + native :disabled

toggle.thumb: {translate-x-5|translate-x-0} absolute left-0 h-5 w-5 border border-gray-200 rounded-full bg-white shadow group-focus:shadow-outline group-focus:border-blue-300

select.note: state is expressed via semantic classes, not raw Tailwind utilities

focusStatePattern.classes: w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-gray-100 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-[#b8c700] focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#d0df00]/35 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700/80
focusStatePattern.note: hardcoded hex focus ring color ([#d0df00]) rather than the lipu-500/600 token — an inconsistency, not a deliberate second brand color

headerCell.active: border-b-[3px] border-[#c9d82e] bg-[#fafaf3] text-slate-800 dark:border-[#d0df00] dark:bg-[#d0df00]/10

pagination.wrapper: rounded-b-lg flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-2 sm:gap-3 border-t border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-2 py-2 dark:bg-gray-800/80
pagination.navButton: inline-flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40

emptyBodyRow.pattern: td.{cellClass|'px-4 py-16 text-center'} > icon circle w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 flex items-center justify-center mb-4; title text-base font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-1; description text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400; optional Lipu::Ui::Button @variant=primary

vendorTablePrimitive.note: @fleetbase/ember-ui table.hbs/table.js exist but are not what real Lipu screens use — data-table/* above is the actual system.

vendorModal.note: Composition shell yielding header/body/footer, backdrop class flb--modal-backdrop. Bootstrap-era, no Tailwind. Real Lipu modals bypass this with custom markup.

vendorDrawer.note: Also a non-Tailwind primitive; real Lipu drawers are custom too.

realModalExample.overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:bg-opacity-75
realModalExample.panel: relative transform overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 shadow-xl w-full max-w-4xl

emptyStates.note: No shared Lipu::Ui::EmptyState component. Two independent local patterns exist.

instances.pattern: div.p-12.text-center > icon circle w-16 h-16 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4; title text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-1; message text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400

kpiSkeleton.pattern: div.animate-pulse.rounded-xl.border.border-gray-200.dark:border-gray-700.bg-white.dark:bg-gray-800.p-4.space-y-3 with bars h-3/h-7/h-2.5 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded

tableSkeleton.pattern: div.animate-pulse.space-y-2.py-4 looping 30 rows of grid-cols-8 gap-3, cells h-4 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-md

loadingAndSkeletons.technique: Tailwind animate-pulse + flat gray blocks; no custom shimmer keyframes.
loadingAndSkeletons.note: animate-spin (~25 occurrences) is the separate pattern used for inline loading spinners (submit buttons, async actions), distinct from these two skeleton components.

infoTooltip.positioning: JS-computed via getBoundingClientRect(), not CSS/popper-based; clamps x to 140px half-width from viewport edges, top = rect.bottom + 8
infoTooltip.popupClass: fixed z-[9999] pointer-events-none w-[280px] rounded-lg border border-green-500 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-950/95 dark:border-green-600 px-3 py-2.5 shadow-md
